relationships.subject: Chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The TREK1 protein in the CCI group significantly decreased compared to that in the Sham group.

relationships.subject: PKA
relationships.evidence_quote: Protein kinase A (PKA) phosphorylates Ser333 at TREK1C end through the second messenger cAMP, causing the closure of TREK1 channel.

relationships.subject: TREK1
relationships.evidence_quote: After local administration of TREK1 channel activator in the anterior cingulate cortex area, the pain behavior of CCI rats and the expression of TREK1 protein were reversed.

key_findings: TREK1 expression and current are reduced in ACC neurons of CCI rats; ACC TREK1 activation relieves pain.
